model_annotations.English: The line plot, titled “Training and Validation Loss,” illustrates the progression of two loss metrics—Training Loss and Validation Loss—over 30 steps, corresponding to Phase 1 (5 epochs) of model training as referenced in the paper “Fast, Not Fancy: Rethinking G2P with Rich Data and Rule-Based Models.” The x-axis, labeled “Steps,” spans from 0 to 30 with a linear scale and tick marks at integer intervals. The y-axis, labeled “Loss,” ranges from 0.025 to 0.200, also on a linear scale, with major gridlines and tick labels at 0.025 intervals. The Training Loss is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers; it begins at approximately 0.200 at Step 0, drops sharply to 0.100 by Step 1, then gradually declines to around 0.055 by Step 30. The Validation Loss, shown as a solid orange line with circular markers, starts at approximately 0.085 at Step 0, decreases rapidly to about 0.050 by Step 5, and continues a slower descent to approximately 0.030 by Step 30, with minor fluctuations observed between Steps 10 and 25. Both lines exhibit a general downward trend, indicating improved model performance over time.
